signature: bool GetVolumesForLocation(const FVector& Location, TArray<AFortVolume*>& Volumes)

callees.0x141c7d8a0: array form of NativeFindVolumeAtLocation: resets Volumes, appends every registered volume whose containment test passes, no duplicates, returns count>0. The containment callee 0x141c82210 is assumed to be AFortVolume::NativeContainsLocation (same test as NativeFindVolumeAtLocation); not separately confirmed.
callees.0x141c82210: volume containment test for an FVector (presumed NativeContainsLocation)

notes: Declared order: Location (struct), Volumes (array ref). The native's loop is an iterate-and-append with an index-based dedupe equivalent to AddUnique. Reset matches the native zeroing of the array count before the loop.
